LESSON: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni
3. Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI
This lesson teaches Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni for Grade 7 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni above.
2. Explain Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni

3.3 Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha

za Kubuni

(Vipindi 2)

Kufikia mwisho wa mada

ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze:

a) kuteua mada na ujumbe

wa kuandikia insha ya

kubuni,

b) kujadili vidokezo

kulingana na mada ya
